scripts.test: npm run test:local && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:kakomonn-live-site && npm run test:kakomonn-live-sync
scripts.test:local: npm run test:repository-naming && npm run test:open-kakomonn && npm run test:release-script && npm run test:live-sync-script && npm run test:kakomonn-reader && npm run test:kakomonn-sync && npm run test:congratulations
scripts.test:kakomonn-reader: npm run build:kakomonn-reader && python3 kakomonn-reader/tests/build_test.py && es-check es2020 kakomonn-reader/kakomonn-reader.user.js && python3 kakomonn-reader/tests/userscript_metadata_test.py kakomonn-reader/kakomonn-reader.user.js
scripts.test:congratulations-production: npm --workspace congratulations run build && node --use-system-ca congratulations/tests/production.mjs
scripts.test:smoke: node kakomonn-reader/tests/smoke_test.js && node kakomonn-reader/tests/learning_metrics_smoke_test.js && node kakomonn-reader/tests/time_limit_smoke_test.js && node kakomonn-reader/tests/webkit_smoke_test.js && node kakomonn-sync/tests/dashboard_e2e_test.js
scripts.deploy:kakomonn-sync: npm run test:kakomonn-sync && npm run test:kakomonn-dashboard && node --use-system-ca node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js deploy --config kakomonn-sync/wrangler.jsonc && npm run test:kakomonn-sync-production
scripts.deploy:congratulations: npm run test:congratulations && node --use-system-ca node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js deploy --config congratulations/wrangler.jsonc && npm run test:congratulations-production
